newsitem.title: JORDAN: King Hussein to make first visit to UAE since 1990.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein to make first visit to UAE since 1990.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan will travel to the United Arab Emirates on Saturday on his first trip to the Gulf state since the 1990 Gulf crisis strained ties between the two countries, palace officials said on Wednesday.
They said the king would meet UAE leader Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan for talks on improving relations between the two countries and to congratulate him on his 30 years of rule.
Jordan angered its Arab Gulf allies six years ago because of its backing for Baghdad after Iraq invaded Kuwait in August 1990, sparking the Gulf crisis.
But Sheikh Zaid, worried by Iraq's subsequent isolation and the growing power of Iran, has called on fellow Gulf states to heal the scars caused by the 1990-91 crisis.

The king, who earlier this year visited Saudi Arabia, Bahrain and Qatar and hosted Sultan Qaboos bin Said of Oman, has begun patching up differences with the Gulf states, once his main financial supporters.
But ties with Kuwait have yet to improve, despite a series of meetings between officials and high-level contacts.
King Hussein wants the Gulf states to employ more Jordanians after it stopped recruiting them during the Gulf crisis.
Prime Minister Abdul-Karim a-Kabariti, a keen advocate of better ties with the Gulf since he formed his government in February, is expected to accompany the king.
